Sketch node `{type: Webhook, note: Receive IFC file upload}` then AI agents + email — not a concrete n8n-nodes-base.webhook export (no path/httpMethod/auth fields). Same incomplete-chain class as previously discarded illustrative @app.post snippets.

Telegram Trigger with Whisper+GPT and DB write, no allowlist. Same missing-Telegram-allowlist class already reported for field/n8n bots; workflow JSON is schematic. Hypothetical /voice-report mobile API is not implemented in the skill.

String values, table/column identifiers, and month in daily_report_summary are interpolated without escaping/parameterization. Builder returns strings only — no execute/network listener. Same library-SQLi class as already-reported erp-data-extractor generate_sql_query.
Unsafe deserialization sinks exist, but load path is operator-supplied local filepath with no untrusted auto-load / webhook. Prior hunts already classified as near-miss.

near_misses.item: CAD-Converters / ifc-qto Python subprocess list argv
near_misses.why: subprocess.run(cmd) with shell=False; paths/options are operator-chosen local args. Not a remote chain unless already controlling the caller. n8n Execute Command path separately already reported for ifc-qto.
bash_command and task_id interpolated into generated DAG source. Inputs come from ConstructionDAGBuilder.add_bash_task caller (operator/templates), no remote ingress.
to_html() interpolates titles/values without escaping. Stored-XSS class already reported for cwicr/kpi/gantt/pdf reports; no public serving endpoint in this skill.
requests.get targets fixed bases (FRED, Open-Meteo, OpenWeatherMap). No attacker-controlled URL → no SSRF chain.
Arbitrary SQL string accepted by helper, but library-only; pipeline extract() uses local excel/pdf folders from config, not extract_from_api. extract_from_api SSRF already reported separately.
Client-side helper posts to caller-supplied webhook_url (operator SSRF/misconfig). Distinct receive-side unauth webhooks already reported; helper itself is intentional operator upload trigger.
No webhook/listener/shell=True/pickle-of-untrusted-remote sinks with attacker-to-impact remote reach beyond already-reported items.
